Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

1. 当前判断

口罩链条仍只能确认“2026年集中涨价”这一方向事实，七条⚔记录同向但未提供相反价格路径，现将冲突调和为重复来源未归并而非多空分歧evidence refevidence refevidence ref。新增两条材料实际指向制造业信用、再贷款与设备窄口径，对口罩本体价格、品类和需求无直接刷新，不能把涨价外推为广谱内需或通胀确认evidence refevidence ref。对th_p_1030156a，口罩仍应作为供给扰动假阳性监控项：若缺5y5y与需求侧确认，单一小品类涨价不触发payer门控[th_p_1030156a]。

2. 关键证据

  • 七条KB头寸均标注2026-01-01集中涨价[price_jump_2026]
  • ⚔记录同向但缺幅度、渠道和SKU口径[contested]
  • 新增904材料是高技术/设备信用重设，非口罩证据evidence ref
  • 新增24f材料强调制造业利用率73.5%，非口罩需求evidence ref
  • 对th_p_1030156a，口罩涨价不能替代5y5y与需求确认[th_p_1030156a]

3. 矛盾 / 待解张力

  • 已调和：七条⚔同向

Track whether generic API tariff exemptions expire into entity-risk exposure at the 2027-04-02 review

Owner: policy-analyst · Thesis v6 · Ticks: 4 · Materials: 29 · Deadline: 7d left · project_id: rp_0bdcbd4455644692

Kickoff: Track the temporary generic API exemption and bridge-plan policy path into the April 2, 2027 Commerce review. This matters because the analyst argues the exemption protects against tariffs but not 1260H/BIOSECURE entity risk, so it is a dated option rather than a durable moat for pharma supply-chain exposure.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the April 2, 2027 Commerce review either extends or converts the exemption into a durable structural protection that also addresses entity-risk exposure, or lets it lapse/narrows it so API and pharma suppliers remain exposed to tariffs, 1260H, and BIOSECURE constraints.

Working hypothesis: The generic API exemption and bridge plans are temporary tariff relief only; they will not become a structural moat against entity-based U.S. pharma supply-chain restrictions.

北方华创可投确定性仍在成熟/特色制程刻蚀与薄膜沉积交付，尚非公开证实的sub-7nm产能级等价替代；这继续支持th_p_65c1f5b1的“工艺级而非全栈突破”，也不推翻th_T09对先进制程叙事的折价约束[thesis:th_p_65c1f5b1][thesis:th_T09]。HAR刻蚀/ALE护城河来自离子能量-角分布、脉冲等离子体、侧壁钝化/去钝化、充电损伤与跨腔体闭环，既有ALE能量窗Emod<eA Kickoff: Track whether the CPI and June FOMC/SEP event gate turns current labor and inflation pressure into a confirmed higher-rate regime. This matters because the analyst is using 10Y UST levels around 4.75%-4.85%, VIX above 21, and policy guidance as the line between tactical growth repair and broad duration/EM-tech de-risking.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when official CPI plus the June FOMC statement/dots either confirm a hawkish regime shift with 10Y UST yields sustaining above the 4.75%-4.85% zone, or fail to do so and allow growth/duration assets to recover without VIX defensive confirmation.

Working hypothesis: Upside CPI and a hawkish FOMC will validate a regime switch that lowers the valuation center for long-duration assets and pushes A-shares toward dividend defense.

1. 当前判断

截至2026-08-03，本闸门仍未resolved：6月通胀降温与7月FOMC偏鹰派按兵不动共同支持th_T04的“2026不降息/更高更久”，但10Y约4.65%仍低于4.75%-4.85%持续确认区，不能升级为已确认加息 regime evidence refevidence ref。真正的价格信号在长端实际利率与期限溢价，而非breakevens；9月前应砍20-30年名义久期、保留前端票息/TIPS/现金凸性，不把暂停误读为风险释放 evidence ref
